topics.purpose: Define immutable accepted policy revisions separately from policy identity, candidate edits and live evaluator snapshot.

semantics.identity_rule: Stable policy identity may have explicit immutable accepted revisions.
semantics.revision_rule: Each accepted revision has exact revision identity/hash/version evidence.
semantics.base_rule: Revision records exact predecessor/base where applicable.
semantics.runtime_rule: Accepted revision and evaluator-active snapshot remain separate until activation succeeds.
semantics.ownership_rule: Policy revision does not alter resource ownership.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

references.purpose: Revisions belong to stable policy identities.
